# Studio 87

## Services

- Hair colouring (染发): Tea brown, cool ash brown, pink brown, milk tea, brown ash, colour correction. https://studio87.com.my/services/hair-colouring/
- Highlights and balayage (挑染与 Balayage): Hand-placed highlights, balayage and highlight refreshes. https://studio87.com.my/services/highlights-balayage/
- Perming (烫发): French perm, natural texture perm for fine or flat hair, men's foil perm. https://studio87.com.my/services/perming/
- Haircuts and styling (剪发与造型): Butterfly cut, everyday styling, curls and evening upstyles, men's cuts. https://studio87.com.my/services/haircuts-styling/
- Grey hair transformation (白发改造): Natural black-tea brown that blends grey, not a flat solid black. https://studio87.com.my/services/grey-hair-transformation/
- Hair treatment and smoothing (头发护理与柔顺): Nakano treatment with colour work, smoothing for frizzy or damaged hair. https://studio87.com.my/services/hair-treatment-smoothing/
- Men's hair (男士发型): Men's cuts, colour, foil perm and texture perm. https://studio87.com.my/services/mens-hair/

No prices are published; quotes are given after a consultation on WhatsApp.
